objective: sum over years of yearly_profit, minus housing_installment * (repayments still due after the last year) * extra_housing for the housing added in each year

year.description: Year of the plan (the notebook's years 1 to 5)
year.label: year

order.description: Position in the horizon (1 = first year). The first year starts from the initial herd, the last year must end with a dairy herd within the final limits, and housing added in a year leaves loan_term_years minus its repayments inside the horizon still to be paid after the last year
order.label: year number

land_group.description: Group of acres on which grain can grow (the notebook's land groups 1 to 4); these acres are part of land_area
land_group.label: land group

area.description: Acres of the group on which grain can grow
area.label: grain-suitable acres

grain_yield.description: Tons of grain harvested per acre of the group; at most grain_yield * area tons a year
grain_yield.label: grain yield per acre

age.description: Age of the animals. Sorted, the youngest age holds the one-year-old heifers (calves raised in a year join it the next year), the oldest holds the cows sold that year at cull_cow_price (they need no housing, land, labour or feed), and the ages in between are dairy cows, which give milk and calves and eat grain and sugar beet (ages 1, 12 and 2 to 11 in the published data)
age.label: age

initial_head.description: Animals of this age in the first year: today's 10 head per age from newborn to 11 years, one year older and net of one year's deaths (9.5 heifers of ages 1 and 2, 9.8 cows of ages 3 to 12). Structural: the starting herd, not a what-if input
initial_head.label: head of this age in the first year

land_area.description: Acres of land on the farm, shared by heifers, dairy cows, grain and sugar beet
land_area.label: farm area (acres)

housing_capacity.description: Places in the existing housing; heifers (calves being raised and one-year-olds) and dairy cows each need one
housing_capacity.label: existing housing capacity (cow places)

heifer_acres.description: Acres needed to support one heifer (a calf being raised or a one-year-old) for a year; two thirds of an acre
heifer_acres.label: acres needed per heifer

cow_acres.description: Acres needed to support one dairy cow for a year
cow_acres.label: acres needed per dairy cow

beet_yield.description: Tons of sugar beet harvested per acre; any acre of the farm can grow sugar beet (0 = no sugar beet can be grown)
beet_yield.label: sugar beet yield per acre (tons)

grain_per_cow.description: Grain eaten by one dairy cow in a year
grain_per_cow.label: grain eaten per dairy cow per year (tons)

beet_per_cow.description: Sugar beet eaten by one dairy cow in a year
beet_per_cow.label: sugar beet eaten per dairy cow per year (tons)

heifer_labour_hours.description: Labour needed per heifer per year
heifer_labour_hours.label: labour hours per heifer per year

cow_labour_hours.description: Labour needed per dairy cow per year
cow_labour_hours.label: labour hours per dairy cow per year

grain_labour_hours.description: Labour needed per acre of grain per year
grain_labour_hours.label: labour hours per acre of grain

beet_labour_hours.description: Labour needed per acre of sugar beet per year
beet_labour_hours.label: labour hours per acre of sugar beet

regular_labour_hours.description: Labour hours covered each year by the regular labour cost; hours beyond them are overtime
regular_labour_hours.label: regular labour hours per year

regular_labour_cost.description: Yearly cost of the regular labour, paid whatever the plan
regular_labour_cost.label: yearly cost of regular labour

overtime_cost.description: Cost of each labour hour beyond the regular hours
overtime_cost.label: overtime cost per hour

heifer_death_rate.description: Share of heifers that die each year: applied to the calves raised (on becoming one-year-olds) and to the one-year-olds (on becoming dairy cows)
heifer_death_rate.label: yearly heifer death rate

cow_death_rate.description: Share of dairy cows that die each year
cow_death_rate.label: yearly dairy cow death rate

calves_per_cow.description: Calves born per dairy cow per year
calves_per_cow.label: calves born per dairy cow per year

heifer_calf_share.description: Share of the calves born that are heifers; the rest are bullocks, sold shortly after birth
heifer_calf_share.label: share of calves that are heifers

bullock_price.description: Price of a bullock calf, sold shortly after birth
bullock_price.label: sale price of a bullock calf

heifer_calf_price.description: Price of a heifer calf sold at birth instead of being raised
heifer_calf_price.label: sale price of a heifer calf

cull_cow_price.description: Price of a cow sold at the sale age (12 years)
cull_cow_price.label: sale price of a cow at the sale age

milk_revenue_per_cow.description: Yearly revenue from the milk of one dairy cow
milk_revenue_per_cow.label: yearly milk revenue per dairy cow

grain_purchase_price.description: Price paid per ton of grain bought
grain_purchase_price.label: purchase price of grain per ton

grain_sale_price.description: Price received per ton of grain sold
grain_sale_price.label: sale price of grain per ton

beet_purchase_price.description: Price paid per ton of sugar beet bought
beet_purchase_price.label: purchase price of sugar beet per ton

beet_sale_price.description: Price received per ton of sugar beet sold
beet_sale_price.label: sale price of sugar beet per ton

heifer_upkeep.description: Other yearly cost per heifer (calves being raised and one-year-olds)
heifer_upkeep.label: other yearly cost per heifer

cow_upkeep.description: Other yearly cost per dairy cow
cow_upkeep.label: other yearly cost per dairy cow

grain_acre_cost.description: Other yearly cost per acre of grain
grain_acre_cost.label: other yearly cost per acre of grain

beet_acre_cost.description: Other yearly cost per acre of sugar beet
beet_acre_cost.label: other yearly cost per acre of sugar beet

housing_installment.description: Yearly loan repayment per cow place added to housing. A place costs 200, financed by a loan repaid in loan_term_years equal yearly instalments; 39.71 is the book's value at 15% over 10 years (the annuity formula gives 39.85). Not recomputed when loan_term_years changes
housing_installment.label: yearly loan repayment per extra cow place

loan_term_years.description: Number of equal yearly repayments of a housing loan, starting in the year the housing is added; repayments due after the last planning year are charged to the plan in the objective
loan_term_years.label: number of yearly loan repayments

min_final_dairy_cows.description: Fewest dairy cows allowed in the last planning year (today's 100 less 50%)
min_final_dairy_cows.label: minimum number of dairy cows in the last year

max_final_dairy_cows.description: Most dairy cows allowed in the last planning year (today's 100 plus 75%)
max_final_dairy_cows.label: maximum number of dairy cows in the last year

min_yearly_profit.description: Lowest profit (cash flow after loan repayments) allowed in any year; 0 means no year may make a loss
min_yearly_profit.label: minimum profit in any year

decision_variables.herd[year, age]: animals of the age in the year (>= 0): one-year-old heifers at the youngest age, dairy cows in between, cows sold at the oldest (the notebook's Cows)
decision_variables.raise_heifers[year]: heifer calves born in the year and kept to be raised (>= 0; the notebook's Newborn)
decision_variables.sell_heifers[year]: heifer calves sold at birth (>= 0; the notebook's HF_sell)
decision_variables.grow_grain[year, land_group]: tons of grain grown on the land group (>= 0; the notebook's GR)
decision_variables.grow_beet[year]: tons of sugar beet grown (>= 0; the notebook's SB)
decision_variables.buy_grain[year]: tons of grain bought (>= 0; the notebook's GR_buy)
decision_variables.sell_grain[year]: tons of grain sold (>= 0; the notebook's GR_sell)
decision_variables.buy_beet[year]: tons of sugar beet bought (>= 0; the notebook's SB_buy)
decision_variables.sell_beet[year]: tons of sugar beet sold (>= 0; the notebook's SB_sell)
decision_variables.overtime[year]: labour hours beyond regular_labour_hours (>= 0; the notebook's Overtime, which counts hundreds of hours)
decision_variables.extra_housing[year]: cow places added to housing in the year, each financed by a loan (>= 0; the notebook's Outlay, in units of 200 USD)
decision_variables.yearly_profit[year]: profit of the year after loan repayments (>= min_yearly_profit; the notebook's Profit)
decision_variables.final_dairy_cows_headroom: max_final_dairy_cows minus the dairy cows of the last year, in [0, max_final_dairy_cows - min_final_dairy_cows]: the slack of the final-herd range row (Gurobi's RgFinal_dairy_cows); not a measure

constraints.housing[year]: raise_heifers + herd[youngest age] + dairy cows <= housing_capacity + extra_housing added up to and including the year
constraints.grain_feed[year]: grain_per_cow * dairy cows <= buy_grain - sell_grain + sum over land groups of grow_grain
constraints.beet_feed[year]: beet_per_cow * dairy cows <= buy_beet - sell_beet + grow_beet
constraints.land[year]: grow_beet / beet_yield + heifer_acres * (raise_heifers + herd[youngest age]) + sum over land groups of grow_grain / grain_yield + cow_acres * dairy cows <= land_area
constraints.labour[year]: heifer_labour_hours * heifers + cow_labour_hours * dairy cows + grain_labour_hours * grain acres + beet_labour_hours * sugar beet acres <= regular_labour_hours + overtime
constraints.calves_raised[year]: herd[year, youngest age] = (1 - heifer_death_rate) * raise_heifers[previous year], every year after the first
constraints.heifers_calve[year]: herd[year, first dairy age] = (1 - heifer_death_rate) * herd[previous year, youngest age], every year after the first
constraints.ageing[year, age]: herd[year, age] = (1 - cow_death_rate) * herd[previous year, next younger age], for every age above the first dairy age, every year after the first
constraints.calving[year]: raise_heifers + sell_heifers = calves_per_cow * heifer_calf_share * dairy cows
constraints.final_dairy_cows: dairy cows of the last year + final_dairy_cows_headroom = max_final_dairy_cows, so the last year's dairy herd lies in [min_final_dairy_cows, max_final_dairy_cows]
constraints.profit[year]: yearly_profit = milk + bullock and heifer calves sold + cows sold at the sale age + crops sold - feed bought - regular labour and overtime - upkeep of heifers and dairy cows - crop acre costs - housing loan repayments due in the year
